$comment: Rules that live in more than one file. Checked by scripts/rule-invariants.mjs in Plugin CI and /lt-dev:plugin:check. When a rule changes on purpose, change every copy listed here in the same edit, or this config.

identicalSections.name: Reporting Bar of the reviewer agents
identicalSections.heading: ## Reporting Bar

phrases.name: broken callers are in the review's scope, in the command and in the reviewers' bar
every base-repo release passes the review gate, based on the last release tag on origin/main
nest-server-starter is the exception to "No change → no release" in both release gates: its version follows nest-server only
phrases.phrase: its version moves only with a nest-server version

phrases.name: a smoke-test fix in nest-server-starter is pushed without a release, in the skill's smoke gate and in maintain-stack Phase 5
native SQL on MySQL / MariaDB filters by the request's tenant on tenant_id, in the database reference and both reviewers

native SQL rows reach a response only mapped or through named columns, because removeSecrets matched camelCase field names only before nest-server 12.3.1 and a raw row skips the model's field rules, in the database reference and both reviewers
closing line of a change report (English)
closing line of a change report (German)
follow-up dependency gate
phrases.phrase: follow-up that needs this ticket merged goes to `Blocked`, not `Open`

phrases.name: follow-ups are filed, not only noted
phrases.phrase: a ticket that exists only in prose is lost

phrases.name: the detect-lt-dev block headings the dev-server skills and browser reviewers switch on
phrases.phrase: lt-Stack project detected — not yet migrated

phrases.name: the detect-lt-dev block that carries the lt dev URLs, read by the skills and the browser reviewers
agent-memory scopes outside `commit` stay out of staging: .gitignore does not cover a tracked note, so a bare git add -A publishes it
test instructions name every record a step opens or selects as the screen shows it, in the skill and in every template that writes them
a test record Claude could not resolve becomes a line with every value, never a search for the tester
the layout lt dev init accepts; has_dev_layout() in hooks/scripts/detect-lt-dev.sh checks the same files
the guard message nest-server-starter's config.env.spec.ts matches with `: <VAR>\. `; without the text after the period the copied contract test fails for every var
the contract test reads REQUIRED_DEPLOYED_ENV_VARS from config.env.ts, so the table is exported
unit specs, the contract test among them, run in CI through vitest.config.ts and need nest-server-starter's headroom over the 5s default
phrases.phrase: cold CI runners (nest-server-starter's reason). testTimeout: 30000, hookTimeout: 30000,

phrases.name: the auth-link log gate both reviewers check: config env local AND raw NODE_ENV unset (undefined, not empty) or local
the ng-base release commit carries every file version:sync wrote (version.ts too), or publish.yml's check:raw fails on a tag that is already public
ng-base's publish.yml cuts the release notes from the `## [X.Y.Z]` section only; a `###` heading yields none
ng-base-starter's release.yml publishes only lines that are new in the release commit, so the CHANGELOG reaches no earlier commit
phrases.phrase: `CHANGELOG.md` stays out of every commit before the release commit

phrases.name: the starter never ships a local ng-base link; the lockfile check reads the two lines after the package name
rolling back an ng-base sync reverts the sync commit too; A..B leaves A out and the core stays on the new version
the ng-base updater adds optional peers too, as the CLI does, because the app's typecheck compiles every entry point in src/core/
Nuxt gate: an agent with an Angular branch keeps its Nuxt path exactly as written
phrases.phrase: On `nuxt`, or no answer, everything below applies as written.

phrases.name: Nuxt gate: frontend-dev and the frontend vendor converter keep their Nuxt path exactly as written
phrases.phrase: On `frontend: nuxt`, or no answer, everything below applies as written.

phrases.name: Nuxt gate: every other Angular branch names the Nuxt fallback, so a Nuxt project or a failed detection never takes it
Nuxt gate: the Nuxt frontend agents keep their Nuxt skill preload; the Angular skill is read on the Angular branch only
Nuxt gate: the smoke test runs Nuxt unless --frontend=angular is passed
phrases.phrase: Without the flag, or with `--frontend=nuxt`, the run scaffolds a Nuxt app and every step below applies as written.

phrases.name: Nuxt gate: the default smoke run scaffolds Nuxt
an Angular smoke run proves the frontend core is really vendored, because lt fullstack init only warns when the conversion fails
Nuxt gate: /lt-dev:review keeps classifying a Nuxt app the detector does not find (nuxt-base-starter keeps its app in nuxt-base-template/) as Frontend
phrases.phrase: On `frontend: none` the package rule still applies

phrases.name: a vendored Angular app imports ng-base styles from ./core/; the package form fails ng build there
dark-mode token overrides go under :root.dark, which is the selector ng-base uses; a plain .dark loses

forbidden.name: a bare Skill or Skill(lt-dev:*) grant approves every command call, git:ship included (house rule 8a: grant called commands by name)
a `*` in a plugin script path also matches ../ and approves any code (house rule 24c: grant each script by exact name)
permissions.json holds no ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} rule: settings do not expand it, and a resolved path needs a wildcard that also matches ../ (house rule 24c)
a falsy NODE_ENV check in the auth-link log gate lets an empty NODE_ENV through, which resolves to the local block on a deployed stage

contracts.name: small-diff path of /lt-dev:review, which the blast-radius eval case drives
